scene.title: What will you use Gately for?
scene.subtitle: Pick one or more. Only the related features stay on and the sidebar stays short; turn the rest on any time under Settings → Modules.

web.title: Publish home services on a domain
web.desc: Reverse proxy with HTTPS certificates: reach your NAS, Home Assistant and more by your own domain

forward.title: Port forwarding / hole punching
forward.desc: TCP / UDP port forwarding, plus STUN hole punching when you have no public IPv4

ddns.title: Dynamic DNS
ddns.desc: Update DNS records automatically when your home IP changes

mesh.title: Mesh networking
mesh.desc: Tailscale, NetBird and EasyTier connect devices across sites

files.title: File sharing
files.desc: WebDAV, SMB, FTP and File Browser

vps.title: VPS entry point
vps.desc: Protocol routing and an frp server share one public port among several services

all.title: Everything
all.desc: Keep every feature on, good for looking around first

scene.hintAll: With nothing or Everything selected, all features stay on.
scene.hintSome: {count} of {total} modules stay on; the others are turned off (their settings are kept). Gately restarts once after saving.

card.title: Getting started
card.allDone: All done. You can close this card now
card.closeConfirm: The Getting started checklist will no longer be shown. Close it?

site.title: Publish your first site
site.desc: Enter a domain and a backend address; the listener and site are set up in one go

https.title: Turn on HTTPS for a site
https.desc: Use an existing certificate or request one with DNS or HTTP validation

ddns.title: Point your domain at this device
ddns.desc: Add a dynamic DNS task that updates records when the IP changes

portforward.title: Add your first forwarding rule
portforward.desc: Forward a port to a device on your network, such as SSH on a NAS

stun.title: No public IPv4? Try STUN hole punching
stun.desc: Get a port reachable from the internet behind a full-cone NAT

mesh.title: Join a mesh network
mesh.desc: Add a Tailscale, NetBird or EasyTier instance

fileuser.title: Add a shared user
fileuser.desc: Sign-in accounts and folders shared by WebDAV, SMB and FTP

fileservice.title: Turn on a file service
fileservice.desc: Pick WebDAV, SMB, FTP or File Browser

protoroute.title: Add a protocol routing rule
protoroute.desc: Serve HTTPS, SSH, frp and more on a single port

frps.title: Start the frp server
frps.desc: Let frp clients at home publish services through this VPS

security.title: Add a second sign-in factor
security.desc: Turn on two-step verification or register a passkey

check.title: Run the network self-check
check.desc: Find NAT, port, clock and DNS problems early

import.title: Import an existing configuration
import.desc: Migrate from nginx, Nginx Proxy Manager, frp or Lucky

notify.title: Set up notifications
notify.desc: Ready-made templates for failed updates, expiring certificates and sign-in alerts

import.title: Import an existing configuration
import.desc: Pick where you are coming from. Every import can be previewed first.
import.nginx: Paste or upload nginx server blocks and turn them into listeners and sites
import.npm: Upload the .conf files from the nginx/proxy_host folder of its data directory and import them as nginx configuration
import.frp: Paste an frpc / frps configuration file
import.lucky: Import a .lkcf file under Settings → Backup & Migration
